climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: A small AVA of about 2,090 acres in the Santa Monica Mountains of western Los Angeles County, with 85 acres of vineyards at 1,800 to 2,000 feet. It is named for a saddle-shaped rock and, since 2014, sits within the Malibu Coast AVA.
